name: hdie_pc_ctrl_cfg-cfg-h3-reflead-COMMIT
purpose: H3 (H-PCCTRL 2026-10-16): measured H2 TT critical path ref_c -> REF lead compare (fanned out to all 32 write-ACT candidates) -> wq_act_physical -> pwin -> wab_oh (-37.9 ps): the compare is now the register ref_lead_q loaded from the same next value ref_c loads (exact, checked equal on every edge of the 54,018-edge policy bench); outline re-sized to util 0.52 from the measured std area 6,327 um2 (H2 gate util 43 %, east third empty). Spine clock kept (H1 default CTS spread 97.7 ps).
